{"notes": "VISIT 1 (1:00). Table state: two chains, both connected to START. Priya's top line reaches about (7.3, 7) and Maya's bottom line about (7.7, 13). Both are roughly the same length and unbroken. Nothing is placed for the tail or the fin yet. Fish is left-facing, nose at start. I can't verify who placed which domino, so I'm going by hands seen at the chain ends and by what people said.

Priya: Hands were at the end of the top chain. She saw the pad was blank, sketched the fish herself (strokes 1/2/3), assigned Maya the bottom, Tom the tail and Leo the eye/fin, and said she'd check for gaps. Strong initiative, clear communication, and she's building while coordinating. Currently the strongest on impact, execution and leadership. Watch that she doesn't carry too much.

Maya: Hands at the end of the bottom chain. She took the bottom line as asked and it's connected and progressing at pace. Said nothing during my visit. Solid execution, quiet. Collaboration is not yet evidenced beyond following the plan.

Leo: Said the plan out loud, but the pad was blank because of his own mistake, and Priya fixed it. He then confirmed her sketch and repeated her assignments, which adds little. He said he'd walk the chain for gaps and take the fin, but he had no hands on the table and no dominoes visible. So far this is talk without output. Don't give him leadership credit for Priya's work. Check on his follow-through next visit.

Tom: Silent, no hands visible, no tail dominoes. I can't judge him. He may be waiting for the body ends to be ready, or may be disengaged. Ask him directly next visit, and ask others privately.

Next visit: check the chain for gaps, whether the tail is started and joined, whether Leo is placing anything, and what Tom is doing."}
